descriptor.name: Madhya Pradesh cadastral maps — indianopenmaps tile snapshot (MPBhulekh_MP_Survey_Cadastrals)
descriptor.scope: Cadastral parcels of Madhya Pradesh from the MPBhulekh_MP_Survey_Cadastrals snapshot that ramSeraph/indian_cadastrals collected from the government map service and serves as vector tiles at indianopenmaps.com. Parcels are rebuilt from zoom-14 tiles. Coverage follows the villages in that snapshot and can omit city cores.
descriptor.attribution: MP Bhulekh survey parcels (webgis2.mpbhulekh.gov.in, reachable only from India). Collected by the Datameet community and ramSeraph (github.com/ramSeraph/indian_cadastrals); vector tiles from indianopenmaps.com. Rebuilt from tiles and adapted to WGS84.
descriptor.licenceNote: The collection is published as CC0 1.0 with a request to credit Datameet and the original government source; the original services state no reuse licence. The tile path is marked "not-so-open" by its maintainer.
caveats: A third-party snapshot of a government cadastral map, not the live register: not proof of current title or ownership, and it does not change when the original does.
Geometry is rebuilt from zoom-14 vector tiles: outlines are snapped to a grid of about 0.6 m and may be lightly simplified compared with the original.

Some outlines overlap (neighbouring village maps were drawn and georeferenced separately). Each overlap is given to the larger outline (equal areas: the lower reference); the smaller parcel shows the rest as derived ground.
Plot numbers are shown as published; application references are derived from each rebuilt outline.
Found and collected by ramSeraph/indian_cadastrals (github.com/ramSeraph/indian_cadastrals). The tiles answer browsers directly (CORS allows any site); no relay is used.

evidence: The frozen packet identifies MPBhulekh_MP_Survey_Cadastrals as the Madhya Pradesh survey-parcel snapshot, bounded to IN-MP and independently reread near the Sagar point. Its identityProvenance.native is false: IDs are snapshot geometry references, not published cadastral numbers.

The snapshot publisher release describes survey parcels and links the government MP Bhulekh service and the exact frozen tile route: https://github.com/ramSeraph/indian_cadastrals/releases/tag/madhya-pradesh . Safe metadata is retained in evidence/published-metadata-inspection.json.

First-party Sagar District Administration lists its local land-records service and city scope at https://sagar.nic.in/en/service/land-records/ . This supports local land-record purpose; it does not prove citywide tile coverage or native alignment.
